title: Chooses different compositions for wide and narrow screens
goal: Use picture to select a wide image or a default close-up based on the viewport.
summary: A wide viewport shows the full path. A close-up highlights the entrance on narrow screens. Both images are embedded so the page works offline.
tasks: Add a media attribute to the source inside picture so the browser uses the wide image only at viewport widths of at least 600px.
Keep img as the default close-up and retain its alt attribute.

example.note: The browser considers source elements in order. If none match, it uses the default image in img.

hint: Use min-width to match viewports at least 600px wide.
